fields.Core Themes JSON: [{"title": "Meditation Over Quick Fix Intentions", "body": "Korinne argued that writing affirmations on water or repeating law of attraction slogans was a form of discipline at best, and that meditation was the key to everything in the occult. She said the new age had sold people an easy path and that prosperity gospel ideas amounted to brainwashing oneself, while the real aim was to break through the subconscious. Chance agreed that a mind that cannot be steadied cannot comprehend the all, and described his own morning routine of meditation, gratitude, and intention setting. Both stressed honesty and action over wishful thinking."}, {"title": "Wishes, Contracts, and Spiritual Materialism", "body": "Chance related The Neverending Story, arguing that a wish for something untrue to yourself costs you a part of yourself, while a daily wish for clarity and truth felt safe to him. Korinne answered a listener question about voiding contracts by describing five years she spent nulling and voiding spiritual agreements in the astral. She urged listeners to learn to meditate so they could say a psychic no from a higher vantage. Chance added that he sometimes noticed lingering presences during his tuning fork sessions."}, {"title": "Gnosticism, Dune, and Pop Culture Occulture", "body": "Korinne argued that Gnosticism pushed through media and simulation theory amounted to nihilism, calling the Piscean age an age of dominance and submission. Chance worried about a buffet style syncretism that ignored what archetypes were, and shared a conclusion from an earlier show that the great work was the inner process while the great reset was the universe forcing the issue. The pair also joked about Dune, fear as the mind killer, and Matrix symbolism. A voicemail from Gabe described weaving fiction and reality as a way of manifesting will."}, {"title": "Memory, Ego, and the Energy Field", "body": "Chance argued that memory lived in the energy field rather than in brain cells, and that memory was largely what made up the ego. Korinne answered that souls remember but time does not exist, summing it up as is, is. She described the ego as a chrysalis that must break for the butterfly to be free, and said spiritual enrichment did not mean a bigger house. Chance suggested the ego metamorphosed instead of vanishing, while Korinne held that it returned to the prima materia. Korinne also argued that the current upheaval was God's way of breaking everyone's ego."}, {"title": "Hermes, Tarot, and Spirit Guides", "body": "Korinne credited Hermes as her spirit guide and operator. A playful Alice in Wonderland deck was shuffled on air and the ten of wands came up, which Korinne called a burden near its end. Chance then drew a past, present, and future spread for America of the Lovers, the Devil inverted, and the Hermit. Korinne argued the inverted Devil meant a coming revelation, while Chance pointed out how unlikely three major arcana were. Korinne advised against store bought Ouija boards in favor of homemade blessed ones, and described working as a psychopomp with Hermes putting people on the phone."}]
fields.Intro Paragraph 1: Join me with conspirituality and pop occulture guru Korinne Wilson, aka the Occult Priestess. She's an old school hollyweird decoder and hermetic homie, who chills like Mercury in a cool rushing river. We had some big fun.
